method: first principles and empirical correlations; no CFD, no FEA; conceptual CAD

stack.name: flight controller + 4-in-1 ESC 45–60 A (30.5 mm stack) + capacitor

fpv.name: FPV camera (micro, 9 g) + video transmitter (10 g) + antenna (5 g) + wires

receiver.name: receiver (2 g) + GNSS puck (8 g: the tailsitter firmware wants a heading)

layout.title: economy: one wing a third of a gate wide, two of the stack's motors, the hover pitch by the elevons in the slipstream

transitions.Apus Mini: both with thrust to spare; the hover pitch by elevons only
transitions.Apus Mini (as printed): both with thrust to spare; the hover pitch by elevons only

Apus Mini: less energy at the quad's 20.target: Wh/km at 20 m/s < half the quad's

Apus Mini: hover pitch with elevons only.target: a 90° pitch-over in the hover under 0.5 s (the quad: ~0.1 s)

Apus Mini: comparable manoeuvre.target: banked turn radius at 20 m/s ≤ the quad's at 45° bank (41 m)

Alcotan: faster sustained.target: sustained top speed (pack 30C, motors 22 A) ≥ 1.25 × the quad's

Alcotan: a chase at 40 m/s.target: endurance at 40 m/s ≥ the quad's at its top speed, with a turn

Gavilan: span for a hangar.target: span ≤ a fifth of a gate (0.30 m)

Gavilan: the quad's hover agility.target: pitch acceleration in the hover ≥ the quad's
